title: Decompose networking contracts and introduce Terraform sidecar modules
creator: Avery Chen
description: Break up the large monolithic networking Terraform templates into composable 'sidecar' modules that encapsulate crosscutting concerns (eg. NAT lifecycle, egress policies, subnet tagging). This reduces plan/apply time, limits blast radius for small changes, and enables per-environment optimization. The work includes defining stable module contracts, creating wrapper blueprints for existing workspaces, and adding CI checks that validate contract compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Existing networking stacks for 'prod-eu' and 'staging-us' can be provisioned with the new sidecar modules without manual changes to environment overlays
Terraform plan time for a typical network change in staging decreases by >= 35% in CI
No functional regressions in routing or NAT failover during canary apply (validated by smoke tests and synthetic traffic)
Module interfaces are documented in the infra repo README and a Confluence design doc, and have contract tests in CI
steps: Audit current networking templates and enumerate responsibilities per resource group (routing, NAT, eips, subnet tags, flow logs)
Design sidecar module API (inputs/outputs) and versioning strategy (semantic, backwards-compatible shims)
Implement sidecar modules in infra/modules/network-sidecars and decompose one workspace as a pilot
Add Terraform unit/contract tests and CI gating; measure plan times and iterate
Roll out to additional workspaces with canary applies and runtime verification
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with infra and platform teams. Aligned on goals: reduce plan churn, isolate NAT lifecycle, and make subnet tagging consistent. Action: inventory mapping assigned to Marcus.

2026-02-18: Inventory completed. Found three areas of repeated code: NAT allocation & failover, subnet tagging & metadata, and egress routing policies. Created initial sidecar API proposals and shared in #infra-engineering.
2026-02-24: Prototype sidecar for NAT lifecycle implemented under infra/modules/network-sidecars/nat-sidecar. Local apply against staging workspace succeeded. Initial plan time improved ~28% locally.

2026-02-27: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1824 with module code and pilot workspace changes. Requesting design review from Sofia Alvarez and security review from Priya Natarajan.

2026-03-01: Feedback from design review: prefer explicit lifecycle inputs and sanitize default tags. Security review flagged IAM role scoping for the NAT allocator; Marcus to tighten policies before merge. CI contract tests added but one transient test failing intermittently — investigating flakiness.
